caveats.statement: Season labels use slash format like '2010/2011', not plain years, so year filters must match the label.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fld075 FROM tab07 LIMIT 20

caveats.statement: Match dates may include time components, so date filters need prefix/LIKE matching rather than equality.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fld004 FROM tab07 WHERE fld004 LIKE '%:%' LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Birth dates are stored as strings; age must be computed by parsing, and larger birthdate means younger player.
League and country share the same column fld048, so filtering by country vs league name must be distinguished.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fld048 FROM tab03 LIMIT 20

caveats.statement: Team names may have inconsistent spellings/casing, so team filters can miss matches.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fld051 FROM tab05 LIMIT 20
